Global Sales Overview 
 
 AI is rapidly moving beyond research labs and into the real world—powering advancements in vehicles, factories, hospitals, homes, and everyday devices. NXP’s Global Sales organization is the force that transforms our intelligent edge vision into meaningful market impact. We operate on the front lines of innovation, delivering real world AI, secure edge intelligence, and breakthrough technologies to the customers shaping tomorrow’s world. As a strategic partner at the intersection of customer ambition and NXP capability, our global sales team drives alignment, opens new markets, and builds the relationships that lead to design wins and revenue growth. Through deep market insight and long term collaboration, we embed customer centricity into every decision and help accelerate innovation at the system solution level. This disciplined, client first mindset enables us to architect integrated, future ready solutions that deliver sustained value and strengthen NXP’s competitive advantage. We thrive in a high performance, high ownership environment—competing boldly, executing with urgency, and celebrating results. If you want to win big, grow fast, and work with the customers building what’s next, NXP Global Sales is where ambition becomes achievement. 
 
 Position Overview 
 As a Embedded AI MPU Field Application Engineer, you’ll be one of the key players in the Customer Application Support team and part of a worldwide technical community providing premium technical support to NXP customers and their projects. You drive demand creation and design-in activity at customer sites in close cooperation with the NXP business lines; you provide technical skills & support to NXP’s sales staff and will work with the NXP technical community about technical issues and future roadmap of your customer(s). We rely on you to deliver the NXP value message in a persuasive and accurate manner, in order to increase our market share.
 
 Key Responsibilities for the role: 
 Deliver premium technical support in content and time to assigned customers

 Accountable to drive design wins in their target accounts and target technology

 Leads proof of concept, solution design and demonstrations to secure NXP solution’s design-in

 Synthesizes customer and competitive insights to improve product definition and roadmaps

 Direct the NXP design-in campaigns for assigned customers to ensure early involvement in the customer’s technology roadmap and timely flow of information to all necessary parties within NXP and customer

 Qualifies the value proposition of NXP's products (strengths versus competitive products) and quantifies the technical benefits derived from choosing NXP

 Own the system software architect role to ensure broader technical team understands the software value proposition for system proposals

 Successfully build relationships with sales team members, business lines, partners and customers in support of sales team objectives

 Analyze customer's technical objectives through the use of relevant data gathering techniques enabling the sales team to be more predictive, effective and responsive to customer needs

 Assist in educating Field Sales Engineers on new technologies, new product features and their related business value

 Develops system level knowledge of target application spaces in Industrial and IoT vertical markets

 
 Key Success Attributes 
 Manage projects on both detailed technical and high-level abstraction levels

 Ability to influence and communicate the value of NXP’s products, based on inspiration, motivation and product expertise

 Flexible; adapts to plans easily when circumstances change

 Is aware of cultural differences and adapts his/her behavior accordingly

 Feels challenged by initiating and driving innovations

 Comfortable working in a target driven environment/working with revenue targets, raising the bar to meet (quarterly) targets and enhance the company’s market share

 High level of integrity, credibility, tenacity and commitment to excellence

 Curious about target customer needs, competitor technology, the eco system and next generation technologies

 Builds a reputation of being the go-to person for regional and business line teams to create opportunities to win and problem solve

 
 Essential Requirements 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 5 years development engineering or applications support of microprocessor based embedded systems

 Field Application Engineering experience in the semiconductor industry

 Experience with C and C++ and a record of developing embedded firmware

 Demonstrated knowledge of typical SoC hardware interfaces (Ethernet, MIPI, SDIO, LP DDR4/5, Quad/Octal SPI, USB2.0/3.0, UART)

 Knowledge of ARM Cortex A, M and R based architectures and register programming models

 Experience using Real-Time OS systems: QNX, FreeRTOS and Zephyr preferred

 Knowledge in embedded Linux is essential: kernel, user-space and uboot environments

 Hands on knowledge of graphics and video subsystems and related software drivers helpful

 Knowledge of Edge AI applications deployment is beneficial

 Familiarity with CNNs, LLMs, VLMs, Agentic AI a plus

 Ability to read, understand and review schematics and provide design recommendations highly desirable

 Willing to travel up to 30% within continental US

 Experienced in providing technical training to sales staff and distributors

 Proven track record of quickly learning new technologies

 Develop system level understanding of target end-applications

 
 More information about NXP in the United States... 
 
 NXP is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, NXP will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.
